positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses product and service design in view of addressing water-related issues and preservation of marine resources
产品服务设计的水与海洋保护政策

Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses product and service design in view of addressing water-related issues and preservation of marine resources。产品服务设计的水与海洋保护政策。水管理、取用采购、水处理、污染预防、风险区减量及海洋保护分开。高水压力区域未采纳政策的说明不能当作集团全部无政策。
